terms:
Welcome to flowday (the "Service"). By signing up for or using the Service, you confirm that you have read and agree to these Terms.

3. You may not use the Service for anything illegal, create accounts in bulk, or attack or disrupt the Service. If you do, we may suspend or close your account.

2. About the content
The calendar, scores, suggestions and other content are calculated from rules based on the traditional Chinese calendar and Five Elements theory. They are for fun and reflection only, are not guaranteed to be accurate, and are not a basis for any decision.

3. Free trial and membership
1. New users get 2 free days of use. Using the Service several times on the same calendar day (Beijing time) counts as 1.
2. After the free trial, a monthly membership is needed to keep using the Service. A membership lasts 30 days and does not renew automatically; renewing during an active membership extends it.
   Memberships bought with an international card or PayPal through Gumroad renew monthly or yearly. You can cancel at any time using the link in your Gumroad receipt email, and you keep access until the end of the current period.
3. Members can use Ask as often as they like at no extra cost; the free trial includes 1 Ask. Special-edition omamori charms can be bought one at a time and never expire. Members can collect 1 basic omamori each month.
4. Memberships and single purchases are digital services and are generally non-refundable once activated. For problems such as double charges or a membership that did not activate, contact us through "Feedback" and we will look into it.

4. Changes to the Service
We may change features or prices, or end the Service, as needed. Price changes do not affect memberships that are already active. We will post a notice in the app before ending the Service.

5. Other
These Terms are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. If you have any questions, contact us through "Feedback".
privacy:
We care about your privacy. This policy explains what information flowday collects, and how we use and protect it.

1. What we collect
1. Account information: your username and an encrypted version of your password (we can never see your actual password).
2. Profile information: the name, bio, date of birth, time of birth, city of birth and gender you choose to provide. We use these to create your calendar.
3. Usage information: the days you use the Service, your plans, daily check-ins, Ask history, omamori charms, invitations and settings. We use these to count free days, give invitation rewards and remember your preferences.
When you use Ask, your question, the topic you chose and the reading calculated by our rules are sent to an AI to write a plain-language interpretation. Your account, name and birth details are not included.
4. Order information: order number, amount, payment status and payment transaction number. We never receive your payment account password or bank card details.
5. Feedback: what you send us, your contact details, and the page and browser you were using when you sent it.

2. How we use it
Only to run and improve the Service, process orders and after-sales requests, and reply to your feedback. We do not sell your personal information or share it with third parties, except where the law requires it.

3. Storage and protection
Your information is stored on our servers and encrypted in transit (HTTPS). Passwords are stored only as salted hashes. We back up data regularly and limit who can access it.

4. Your rights
You can view and edit your profile at any time in "My profile", and delete your account yourself at the bottom of that page. When you delete your account, your profile, plans, lots, check-ins, Ask history, omamori charms, feedback and invitations are deleted immediately. For accounting, orders keep only the amount, time and payment transaction number, and are no longer linked to you.
The link for subscribing in your phone's calendar contains only a random token and no birth details, and you can reset it at any time.

5. Contact us
If you have any questions about this policy, contact us through "Feedback".
